scope: Exact fresh and encrypted historical dedicated Drive client/token/code/verifier/confirmation values, administrator session cookies and existing fixture credentials in public artifacts, all private test logs, actual status API/events and current argv. Values remained in memory.
limits: No OCR or universal proof of absence of every possible derived secret.
Status APIs exclude intended private authorization and recovery-kit export endpoints.
Process arguments reflect only this scan time.
inspection_adjustment: The events endpoint supports documented JSON polling and SSE; both response modes are checked without printing their contents.
